authorizationText: 单独授权 Gate14Re‑ME qualification input schema compatibility offline closure adjudication attempt‑005：完整保留 attempt‑004 的失败状态、Status v24、全部证据和残留隔离缓存，不删除、不修改、不改判 attempt‑004；禁止重新启动 Unity。仅允许创建并冻结独立只读离线裁决器，重新核对 attempt‑004 的 authorization/stage/source freeze、prelaunch/live/post-exit 外部指纹、attempt‑007 时间戳比较结果、process launch receipt、in-process ready snapshot、Unity terminal schema receipt、自然退出码、源码与既有证据目录摘要，以及全部禁止行为计数。仅当证据证明 schema compatibility 全部断言通过、三阶段 trusted identity 全部通过、Unity 自然退出为零、失败仅发生于科学结果完成后的空目录缓存大小统计，并且不存在调度、输入、身份映射、measured root、planner 或算法 lane 活动时，才允许以 attempt‑005 身份冻结 terminal PASS receipt、Status v25，并正式采用 input schema v2 与 planning schema binding v2；不得修改或重新分类 attempt‑004。任一证据缺失或不一致均立即 fail closed。仍禁止生成调度、输入 bundles 或匿名身份映射，禁止创建 measured root，禁止 planner、算法 lane、正式采集、正式分析、排名和赢家裁决。
authorizedActions: create one independent attempt-005 evidence directory
create and execute one offline read-only adjudicator
read and revalidate the frozen attempt-004 evidence and retained evidence bindings
invoke the frozen attempt-007 timestamp comparator only on already-frozen timestamp strings
freeze a terminal PASS receipt and Status v25 only if every authorized structural predicate passes
adopt input schema v2 and planning schema binding v2 only after terminal PASS
requiredChecks: attempt-004 authorization, stage contract and source freeze are intact
prelaunch, live-concurrent and post-exit external fingerprints all satisfy trusted identity rule v1
attempt-007 comparator source, known-answer receipt and stored UTC-tick comparisons are intact
process launch receipt, in-process ready snapshot and terminal Unity schema receipt form one composite process identity
all schema compatibility assertions passed and Unity exited naturally with code zero
the terminal attempt-004 failure occurred only after scientific completion at the empty transient-cache size statistic
attempt-004, Status v24 and retained evidence remain byte-identical and are not reclassified
all prohibited scientific-activity counters remain zero or false
prohibitedActions: delete, modify, clean, overwrite or reclassify attempt-004 or Status v24
